data.title: Aucto Partners with Otinus to Bring New Fiber Laser Cutters, Press Brakes and Shears to Its Industrial Equipment Marketplace
data.description: Starting on September 15, 2026, fabricators are now able to purchase brand-new Otinus metalworking machinery with factory warranties through Aucto, an online marketplace for industrial equipment. This partnership offers a fast and user-friendly online buying process. Aucto, located in Bloomingdale, Illinois, is facilitating this initiative, promising convenience for buyers interested in acquiring quality machinery.

data.title: ChatOn Introduces Fact-Checking Feature to Help Users Verify News and AI Responses
data.description: Recently, ChatOn launched a new advanced fact-checking tool to assist users in detecting misleading content and AI-generated falsehoods. The AI chatbot, which boasts an impressive 100 million downloads, introduced this feature in Miami on September 15, 2026.

data.title: Embracing the Adventure Behind the Wheel, Jiffy Lube Teams Up with Rebelle Rally, an 8-Day Off-Road Navigation Competition
data.description: In Houston on September 15, 2026, Jiffy Lube, a prominent provider of quick oil changes and automotive maintenance, revealed its sponsorship of the 2026 Rebelle Rally. This renowned off-road navigation event is exclusively for women. Jiffy Lube will have a significant presence as the presenting sponsor of the Rally, showcasing its support for the competition.

data.title: World Leader Explore Industries Opens First West Coast ExploreBase to Accelerate Dealer Growth
data.description: Today, Explore Industries, the top producer of fiberglass swimming pools globally, announced a significant investment in expanding regional inventory. This initiative aims to reduce transportation costs, expedite product availability, and enhance localized dealer support. The investment comes as Explore Industries continues to solidify its position as a key player in the swimming pool market. The company, based in Knoxville, Tennessee, disclosed this development on September 15, 2026.

data.title: Nicklaus Children's Hospital is No. 1 Pediatric Hospital* in Florida in U.S. News & World Report 2026-2027 Rankings
data.description: Nicklaus Children's Hospital in Miami has been named one of the Top 50 children's hospitals in the nation for the 18th year in a row. This recognition includes eight specialty programs that are ranked among the best in the country. Additionally, all four institutes under the hospital were acknowledged. The hospital holds the prestigious title of being the top-ranked pediatric hospital in Florida. This accomplishment solidifies Nicklaus Children's Hospital's position as a leader in providing high-quality healthcare to children.

data.title: Luxury Living: Texas Style TV Series Spotlights Greater Houston Real Estate and Lifestyle on REAL Shows Network
data.description: Tricia Turner and Amy Lampman are set to host a new series focusing on luxury homes, new construction, and local lifestyle, emphasizing the unique relationships within Greater Houston. The series will be aired on REAL Shows Network (RSN), a national television platform. The announcement was made in Houston on September 15, 2026, by RSN.

data.title: Work With Your Handz Named to the 2026 Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
data.description: A recruiting agency specializing in skilled trades has been ranked as No. 4713 overall and No. 123 among staffing and recruiting companies in the United States. The company, based in HAYMARKET, Va., made this impressive achievement on September 15, 2026. Work With Your Handz is known for offering workforce solutions to skilled trade sectors and service-oriented businesses on a national level.

data.title: The State Group Appoints Mark Funk as Chief Operating Officer
data.description: State Group, a prominent technical services contractor in North America, has recently appointed Mark to strengthen its executive team in preparation for further growth. The company made this announcement on September 15, 2026, in Franklin, Tennessee. This strategic move demonstrates State Group's commitment to investing in its development, highlighting its focus on the next phase of expansion.

data.title: Jubilant Therapeutics Announces First Preliminary Clinical Data from Ongoing Phase 1/2 Study of JBI-802 in Patients with Myeloproliferative Neoplasms at SOHO 2026
data.description: A recent presentation showcased promising findings indicating that a dual LSD1/HDAC6 inhibitor is effective in reducing platelet counts in patients with essential thrombocythemia (ET). The data revealed rapid and sustained dose-dependent reductions in platelet levels. The inhibitor also displayed consistent efficacy in patients with polycythemia vera (PV) and in other related conditions. This suggests a potential therapeutic benefit for individuals with these blood disorders.

data.title: From Texas to Chicago: Doc Watkins Brings His Vision of the Modern Jazz Supper Club to Lincoln Park
data.description: Renowned jazz pianist and entrepreneur Doc Watkins will debut Doc's Jazz Club at NEWCITY in Chicago in March 2027. The city, known for its deep jazz roots, eagerly awaits this new live music and dining hotspot. Scheduled to open in the March of 2027, Doc's Jazz Club promises to offer a unique nightlife experience in Chicago, a city revered for its rich jazz history.

data.title: Corgan and University of Arkansas Research Explores How Workplace Design Influences Attention and Focus
data.description: Corgan, an architecture and design company based in Dallas, has recently published award-winning research focusing on neurodiversity, ADHD, and workplace design. The study aims to enhance focus and overall well-being in the workplace environment.

data.title: Lorient Opens New York Office, Expanding U.S. Footprint
data.description: Lorient, a healthcare-oriented investment firm managing around $2 billion in assets, revealed the launch of its latest office in New York City, marking its expansion in the U.S. With the new Midtown East location, it becomes Lorient’s third office in the country, alongside sites in Birmingham, Michigan, and Miami, Florida. The New York office will commence operations with six professionals on board, boosting the firm's team and investment capabilities.

data.title: LNL Capital Appoints Joel Tomlinson as Managing Partner to Oversee Net Lease Capital Strategy
data.description: In New York, LNL Capital, a net lease capital platform, has named Joel Tomlinson as Managing Partner to develop the Company's structured debt and equity strategy in the single-tenant retail, industrial, and healthcare net lease sectors. With this appointment, LNL Capital aims to expand its presence in these markets by leveraging Tomlinson's extensive experience. Tomlinson's expertise spans across the triple net retail sector, focusing on sale-leasebacks and recognizing value-add and opportunistic transactions. This strategic move signifies the Company's commitment to growth and innovation in these areas.

data.title: Masco Corporation Appoints Yaron Ben David as Chief Technology and AI Officer
data.description: Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) headquartered in Livonia, Michigan, disclosed the hiring of Yaron Ben David as the Chief Technology and AI Officer, effective from September 15, 2026. Ben David, appointed to the position by President and CEO Jon Nudi, will join Masco’s Executive Committee. This role has been newly established to reinforce Masco’s commitment to enhancing capabilities that drive growth, innovation, and value across its array of renowned brands.

data.title: Newsweek Names LP Building Solutions One of America’s Greatest Companies
data.description: LP Building Solutions, based in Nashville, Tennessee, has recently been recognized as one of America’s top companies for the year 2026 by Newsweek. This prestigious honor underscores the company's excellence and success in the industry.

data.title: Sagard Real Estate Expands Fulton Industrial Presence with Atlanta Acquisition
data.description: Atlanta's Sagard Real Estate, a top real estate investment advisor under Sagard, an asset management firm, has purchased 5070 Phillip Lee Drive SW in Atlanta. This industrial property spans 400,800 square feet in the Fulton Industrial area. The acquisition was done for Sagard Real Estate's open-end core-plus real estate fund. The property includes four connected warehouse buildings.
